data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 gross claims outstanding were GBP 39.487m. During 2014 the Syndicate recorded a prior-year release of technical reserves of GBP 9.5m (release  24.1% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven primarily by favourable claims development and settlements (including outcomes on a medical isotope claim and Urenco-related losses) together with currency movements that reduced Yen-denominated reserves (Hamaoka). No gross claims development triangle is presented; the GBP 9.5m movement is the reported movement in prior years in the accounts.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement is taken from Note 4 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a release of GBP 9.5m. The note provides only a single figure and does not explicitly show gross vs reinsurer's share columns; this extraction treats the GBP 9.5m as the reported prior-year movement (gross for the purpose of this file) with moderate confidence. No gross claims development triangle was provided in the accounts for cross-checking. Several event amounts are described in narrative and are partially quantified; where a precise gross PY movement by LOB was not provided, amounts are left null.
